# mooncake explain

Look up typed information about a mooncake noun (action verb, run, resource, op)

## Flags

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `--format / -f` | string | `text` | Output format: text, json, or yaml |
| `--examples-limit` | int | `3` | Max example excerpts to include for kind:action results |
